capabilities: Open a real system shell (PowerShell, bash, zsh) in the right sidebar
Run interactive programs with colors, Tab completion, history and Ctrl+C
Start the shell in the vault folder and resize with the panel
Match the Obsidian theme's monospace font and colors
Kill the shell and its child processes when the panel closes
extras: On Flatpak installs, the plugin needs a sandbox permission granted via flatpak-spawn --host; macOS builds are untested; the platform helper binary is written to disk from main.js on first terminal open; the plugin itself is unreviewed by Obsidian staff; security issues must be reported privately per SECURITY.md.
motivation: The author avoided node-pty (breaks on Electron updates) and Python helpers (needs Python, no pty on Windows) and chose a single dependency-free Go binary per system.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in terminal, so running shell commands in the vault folder means switching to a separate app.
summary: Terminal emulator for the right sidebar that runs the system shell via a bundled Go PTY helper, starting in the vault folder.
